role: The /me command: broadcasts a chat.type.emote line from the sender.
scope_reason: In scope since lane/idxclient: the chat takes typed input (GuiChat, the live client's T and slash), so a player types commands; the integrated server without cheats answers each (only tell, me, help and seed are allowed) and its tab completion reads the command map (csrc/engine/chatcmd.c).

members.name: addTabCompletionOptions
members.note: cov-tabme-s1: "/me " and "/me waves at P" then Tab

notes: lane/idxclient: chat.type.emote with each word a selector may stand for (func_147176_a with the sender allowed "me"). idx-chattype-s1.
